Definition: Taanak or Tanak, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Taanach or Tanach = "sandy"; 1) an ancient Canaanite city conquered by Joshua and allotted to the half tribe of Manasseh although in the territory of Issachar; given to the Kohathite Levites; located on the west of the Jordan and near the waters of Megiddo
